svg.title: Appendix A1: where Lactifluus sits next to Strimzi and the Debezium operators
svg.desc: Strimzi runs Kafka on Kubernetes. Debezium can run on Kafka Connect or as a standalone Server, each with its own operator. Lactifluus sits on top of a running Debezium Server and adds metrics, slot diagnosis and a proposed policy and reaction layer. From public docs read on 2026-11-05; not an exhaustive audit.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: APPENDIX A1 · FOR QUESTIONS, NOT PRESENTED
